repos.description: Run frontier MoE models on hardware you already own — pure C, zero deps, experts streamed from disk. Tiny engine, immense model. 🐦
repos.intro: Tiny engine, immense model. colibri runs very large open models on the machine you already have. A mixture-of-experts model of hundreds of billions of parameters uses only a small part of itself for each token, so colibri keeps that part in RAM and reads the rest, the experts, from the disk when the model asks for them…
features: RAM is two numbers: below the first the model does not start, from the second it runs as measured.
GPU is what the setup can build for that engine ( GPUs ). Integrated too means it also uses an integrated GPU, where these engines were meas…
Measured is what was timed on the machine named, decode speed for the chat models. The letters are machines listed under the tables.
repos.description_zh: 在您現有的硬體上執行頂尖的 MoE 模型 —— 純 C 語言、零依賴、專家模型從磁碟串流。微型引擎，巨大模型。 🐦
repos.intro_zh: 微型引擎，巨大模型。colibri 在您現有的機器上執行極大型的開源模型。擁有數千億參數的混合專家 (mixture-of-experts) 模型在處理每個 token 時僅使用其一小部分，因此 colibri 會將該部分保留在 RAM 中，並在模型需要時從磁碟讀取其餘部分（即專家模型）……
features_zh: RAM 有兩個數字：低於第一個數字模型無法啟動，從第二個數字開始則可依測量值執行。
GPU 是該引擎可以為之建構的配置 ( GPUs )。整合 (Integrated) 也代表它同樣支援使用整合式 GPU，在這些引擎被測量時……
測量值是指在指定機器上針對聊天模型解碼速度所進行的計時。字母代表表格下方列出的機器。
repos.description_src: Run frontier MoE models on hardware you already own — pure C, zero deps, experts streamed from disk. Tiny engine, immense model. 🐦

repos.description: Worktrunk is a CLI for Git worktree management, designed for parallel AI agent workflows
repos.intro: Worktrunk is a CLI for git worktree management, designed for running AI agents in parallel.
features: Hooks — run commands on create, pre-merge, post-merge, etc
LLM commit messages — generate commit messages from diffs
Merge workflow — squash, rebase, merge, clean up in one command
Interactive picker — browse worktrees with streaming CI status and diff, log, PR and comment previews
Share build caches — ten worktrees get target/ , node_modules/ , etc without building or copying them (on APFS, btrfs, and XFS)
wt list --full — CI status and AI-generated summaries per branch
repos.description_zh: Worktrunk 是一個用於 Git worktree 管理的 CLI，專為並行 AI agent 工作流而設計
repos.intro_zh: Worktrunk 是一個用於 git worktree 管理的 CLI，專為並行執行 AI agents 而設計。
features_zh: Hooks — 在建立、pre-merge、post-merge 等階段執行指令
LLM commit messages — 從 diffs 生成 commit messages
Merge workflow — 使用單一指令完成 squash、rebase、merge 與清理
Interactive picker — 瀏覽 worktrees，並提供串流式的 CI 狀態以及 diff、log、PR 與 comment 預覽
Share build caches — 十個 worktrees 可以共用 target/、node_modules/ 等內容，無需重新建置或複製（支援 APFS、btrfs 與 XFS）
wt list --full — 顯示每個分支的 CI 狀態與 AI 生成的摘要
repos.description_src: Worktrunk is a CLI for Git worktree management, designed for parallel AI agent workflows
